summary: Marti Technologies, Inc. provides tech-enabled urban transportation services to riders in Turkey. It operates a mobility app that provides multiple transportation services, such as a ride-hailing service which matches riders with car, motorcycle, and taxi drivers, as well as operates a fleet of e-mopeds, e-bikes, and e-scooters. The company was founded in 2018 and is headquartered in Istanbul, Turkey.
